blocking_inconsistencies.description: docs/integrations/lump_sum_budget_planner/received/ contains no lump-sum budget response (only a .gitkeep placeholder is present). No externally supplied budget response file exists to validate for interface-contract conformance or for structural consistency against wp_structure.json.
blocking_inconsistencies.resolution_note: Absent budget artifacts in received/ constitute a blocking gate failure, not a hold or pending state, per CLAUDE.md §8.4 and §13.4. Mode B Step B.1.1 halts before any conformance, WP-coverage, or partner-coverage check; those checks could not be performed because no response file is available. This lump-sum interface validation cannot declare the budget gate passed. Resolution requires a conforming lump-sum budget response to be delivered to the received/ directory and re-validated.
